message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes from facts.

Facts: In 2009, defendant Tang signed lease contract for a car, rent monthly 6000. After term, he paid part of rent to continue renting the car fraudulently. In 2010 July, he used the car as collateral to get a loan of 30,000 via fish. The car was recovered and returned to victim. The car value 50500. So crimes: fraud (骗租) maybe "诈骗". Also "非法占有" maybe "诈骗". Also "非法获取公民个人信息"? No. "非法持有毒品"? No. "盗窃"? He didn't steal; he fraudulently obtained car usage and used as collateral. That's fraud. Also maybe "非法占有" but not in list. "诈骗" is the label for credit card fraud, but also general fraud. So answer: 诈骗.

Check if also "非法占有" not in list. "诈骗" is correct.

Thus final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
